endorsements.name: T3 - Fred Trotter, CISSP
endorsements.label: Operating System Fingerprinting Library
endorsements.description: This is a fingerprinting library designed to bring together the fingerprinting capabilities of NMAP, QueSO and X (at least version 1). Using this library you should be able to add operating system sensitive code to your favorite Perl, Java, C or C++ code.
